commentDifference: // is an inline single-line comment, while /* */ spans across multiple lines.
nestedComments: Block comments cannot nest because the inner */ closes the outer block prematurely.
preprocessorRole: The preprocessor strips all comments before compiling, keeping machine code clean.
docCommentExample:
/**
 * @brief Validates user authorization.
 * @param userId Unique user ID.
 * @return True if permitted.
 */
